'''Outpost Onith''' was an outpost of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] located in the [[Highmount Ridge]] region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and subsequent [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
